title: Fabulously Crafted
description: Fabulously Crafted reimagines your game with breathtaking next-gen visuals without sacrificing a single frame of performance. This vanilla plus modpack is the ultimate client-side upgrade for builders and explorers alike!
body:
# Fabulously Crafted

**Fabulously Crafted** is the ultimate client-side overhaul for Minecraft, designed to bridge the gap between "next-gen" visuals and high-speed performance. This modpack transforms the game into a breathtaking visual experience using [Distant Horizons](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://modrinth.com/mod/distant-horizons) and Shaders, while simultaneously providing a robust suite of tools for builders and technical players. It is a merging of the [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) and [Simply Crafted](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://modrinth.com/modpack/simply-optimized) modpacks, taking the best mods from both and creating an optimized Simply Crafted that runs on the current version of Minecraft.

Whether you are looking to take stunning 4K screenshots, build massive structures with precision, or simply explore a world that feels alive, Fabulously Crafted provides the engine to do it.

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🌄 Next-Generation Visuals

Experience Minecraft like never before. This pack is built around [Distant Horizons](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://modrinth.com/mod/distant-horizons), allowing you to see terrain from miles away without the performance cost of standard render distance.

  * **[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris):** Full shader support for realistic lighting and shadows.
  * **Visual Overhauls:** Includes [3D Skin Layers](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&source=gmail&q=https://modrinth.com/mod/3d-skin-layers), [Wavey Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wavey-capes), and [Better Grass](https://modrinth.com/mod/bettergrass) to remove the "flat" look of vanilla.
  * **Immersive Audio:** [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) and [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps) make caves echo and walking on different blocks sound realistic.

### ⚡ Unmatched Performance

Don't sacrifice frames for beauty. Fabulously Crafted is powered by the [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) ecosystem and [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), ensuring your game runs smoother than vanilla even with graphical enhancements turned on.

  * **[Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps):** Saves resources when you tab out.
  * **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling):** Prevents the game from rendering things you can't see.
  * **Fast Load Times:** Optimized to get you into the game quicker.

### 🛠️ The Builder's Toolkit

A dream suite for creative and survival builders. We have included industry-standard tools to help you design and place blocks efficiently.

  * **[Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom):** A powerful, modern building tool (Creative mode) that streamlines large-scale terraforming and detailing.
  * **[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica):** View holograms of your schematics to build complex structures in Survival with ease.
  * **[Visual Workbench](https://modrinth.com/mod/visual-workbench):** See your items physically on the crafting table.

### 🎮 Quality of Life

Small tweaks that make a huge difference in gameplay:

  * **[Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) & [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap):** Never get lost again with a clean, integrated map UI.
  * **Inventory Management:** Sort chests and move items quickly.
  * **[Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify):** Full controller support (Xbox, PS5, etc.) if you prefer a gamepad over keyboard/mouse.
  * **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify):** A smooth, configurable zoom key for spotting details afar.

-----

## ⚠️ Multiplayer & Server Safety

**Please Read Before Joining Public Servers:**

This modpack contains modifications that may be considered "unfair advantages" or "cheats" on strictly vanilla or competitive servers (e.g., Hypixel, PvP servers).

  * **[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica):** Often allowed for visuals, but "Easy Place" mode is frequently banned.
  * **[Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap):** This pack includes entity radar settings. Ensure this complies with your server's rules.
  * **Freecam/Camera Mods:** Check with server administrators before using camera detach tools.

*The user assumes all responsibility for complying with specific server rules.*

-----

## 📥 Installation

1.  Download the `.mrpack` file from the Versions tab.
2.  Import the file into your launcher of choice (Modrinth App, Prism Launcher, etc.).
3.  Launch and enjoy a Fabulously Crafted world\!
